title: Coactivity and compartment investigation from measured spine plasticity
disposition_reason: The historical complete20-mouse declaration describes public-outcome investigation, whereas the original definition mixes investigation with held-out prediction. This revision separates numerical investigation correctness from predictive generalization; the declared trusted grader and producer are absent from current source.

scientific_target.question: After accounting for baseline size, movement activity and compartment, what mouse-balanced associations link local coactivity to later spine plasticity, and how stable are they under mouse deletion and matching?
scientific_target.known_answer: Prespecified conditional coactivity and compartment-interaction estimates, their support, and matched baseline-versus-neural held-mouse loss differences independently recomputed from the same measured spine records. The true conclusion can be null or unresolved.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Baseline/followup morphology and local coactivity fields in archive15047046. Outcomes are published and explicitly available in the historical investigation export; correctness means faithful numerical analysis, not guessing a hidden biological story.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete20-mouse investigation with spine records nested in mouse/FOV/dendrite; individual report terms are not independent cases.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse, with all compartments of an animal kept together.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional observational association in the selected published control cohort. An exposed-outcome analysis may audit a predictive procedure but cannot certify protected future prediction.
exclusions: No causal claim that coactivity creates plasticity.
No protected-heldout claim when later volumes are in the public investigation input.
No score for agreeing with the source paper’s preferred interpretation.

inputs: Complete allowed control-cohort baseline/followup morphology, local coactivity, movement activity, compartment and grouping variables in an operator-verified investigation export.
Use explicit eligible-support/missingness tables; the source audit documents27 members and1143 source rows only via the historical runtime declaration.
forbidden_inputs: Trusted expected numerical report, private reference outputs and evaluator feedback.
For any separately registered prediction arm, query followup outcomes and any derivatives of them.
observation_contract.case_identity: Historical declaration specifies20 mice,27 source members and1143 rows. No public record IDs, corrected export or exact estimator schema are delivered in the current package.
observation_contract.split: Investigation uses exposed published outcomes with grouped sensitivity analyses. Any held-mouse loss audit must refit within folds and keep mouse/compartment overlap together; that is a retrospective analysis and not a secret-label test.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete selected20-mouse declaration only; no current executable export, trusted grader or producer accompanies it. NEURAL-031 shares these controls and is not a second cohort.

primary.name: complete conditional-estimand numerical error
primary.aggregation: Compare all prespecified mouse-balanced coactivity/compartment coefficients and support counts with independent recomputation; report each native-unit discrepancy, with units and tolerances frozen before use.
primary.rationale: A numerical investigation must be scored against reproducible measured-data estimands rather than prose agreement. The retained manifest does not distribute its grading arithmetic, so this is a revised endpoint specification.

secondary: Mouse-heldout baseline-minus-neural MAE with both absolute errors, identified explicitly as an exposed retrospective analysis.
Leave-one-mouse-out effect stability, compartment-specific support and overlap diagnostics.
Multiplicity-adjusted intervals for the prespecified feature/compartment family; no post-hoc best coefficient.

comparators.name: Size/movement/compartment model
comparators.inputs: Initial volume, movement activity and dendritic compartment.
comparators.procedure: Prespecify mouse-balanced fit; choose transformations on development records and use identical support for all nested models.

comparators.name: Local coactivity model
comparators.inputs: Same nuisance covariates plus local coactivity and compartment interaction.
comparators.procedure: Match model family and tuning to nuisance baseline; report full coefficient family even when null.

comparators.name: Dependence-preserving feature null
comparators.inputs: Neural-feature blocks permuted within valid mouse/compartment strata.
comparators.procedure: Use only exchangeability-supported blocks and document failure of overlap; never substitute individual-spine resampling for mouse uncertainty.

nuisance_controls: Account for neuron/dendrite neighbors and overlapping compartments of one mouse.
Match baseline-size distributions and measurement quality; report changes from unmatched to matched support.
Distinguish association coefficients from held-mouse predictive loss; neither implies causality.
evaluation.uncertainty: Mouse-level deletion or cluster resampling of complete mice, preserving nested FOV/dendrite/spine structure. Freeze the feature family and multiplicity policy; undefined/rank-deficient models must remain undefined.
evaluation.failure_policy: Validate complete report terms, units, support and IDs before expected values. Missing, rank-deficient or zero-overlap terms require explicit dispositions; a structurally valid report with wrong values does not pass numerical correctness.

implementation.scorer_target: No current local scorer. Historical metadata says a complete producer plus trusted grader uses corrected source/export arithmetic, but names absent authoring dependencies and states no authentic run.
implementation.delivered_scope: Retained complete20-mouse investigation declaration; source-only lifecycle metadata cannot execute or independently verify the conditional estimands.
missing: Recover corrected source/export, estimator definitions and trusted numerical grader.
Build complete support and missingness roster for the27 members.
Provide a participant investigation interface and matched frozen-procedure comparison without answer-report exposure.
implementation.execution_evidence: The retained exact successor states not_run and no authentic candidate/reference/scorer/native run. No execution or scientific conclusion is added here.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed no-tools numeric or visual presentation of the same permitted measurements specified above. No such participant transport is present.
direct_observation.boundary: Preserve source support and permitted covariates; remove target values and answer-bearing metadata, except measured outcomes explicitly permitted in an investigation.
missing: Define a bounded complete observation presentation and response collector; do not convert programme scores into direct-observation performance.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed rendering of calcium traces, morphology/coactivity summaries or condition comparisons appropriate to this endpoint; current source has no typed viewer.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only fixed render/selection actions return visuals; query hidden targets, raw evaluator files and unrestricted source lookups stay unavailable.
missing: Implement audited task-specific image transport and complete answer collection; no viewer/model result exists here.

tool_assisted.representation: Proposed per-case numerical investigation using the same permitted observations, fixed numerical/model tools and accounted budget.
tool_assisted.boundary: Declare fit/analysis actions and reset state at the biological case boundary; no private evaluator feedback.
missing: No matched interactive investigator transport is delivered; a programme/controller declaration alone does not implement this mode.

frozen_program.representation: A historical frozen-program declaration exists, but its named executable/producer/scorer source is absent from this current checkout.
frozen_program.boundary: Future recovered programme must freeze before query access and preserve the exact declared complete scope; metadata flags do not establish a runnable mode.
missing: Recover the named source/dependency closure and exact public input contract before executing or scoring.

evidence.supports: Preserved original source audit: source measurements, provenance, units, biological identities, caveats and reference entrypoints. Reused as verified source evidence; not proof of current execution.
Historical declared scope, score/run status and actual external-source prerequisites; current tree inspection confirms which executable paths are absent.

evidence.supports: Scientific measurement and paradigm provenance. The source paper is not treated as a correctness answer or proof of task execution.

evidence.supports: Current primary author-data record and immutable archive identity; code/data content claims use preserved original audits and inspected local implementation.

excluded_claims: No causal claim that coactivity creates plasticity.
No protected-heldout claim when later volumes are in the public investigation input.

Programme performance is not evidence of direct-observation or typed-viewer understanding.

summary: Resolve investigation versus prediction access: public outcomes are allowed for investigation, and protected prediction remains a separate unimplemented condition.
Replace story agreement with independently recomputed conditional estimates/support and grouped sensitivity.
Make missing grader/producer source explicit despite complete20 metadata.
revision.source_review: Read original definition/source audit, assigned README and exact current registry-owned implementation inventory; inspected actual scorer/loader where delivered and searched task/shared source for missing declared paths. Rechecked primary author-data metadata only; no biological payload or model run.
